Appearance:
Mr. Rajnish Sharma - Advocate for the applicant.
Mr. Anurag Sharma Dy. Govt. Advocate for respondent/Sta  ORDER
This is the first bail application filed by the applicant.

The application is filed under Section 482 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 on behalf of applicant, who apprehends her arrest in connection with Crime No.15/2025 , registered at Police Station STF Bhopal (Gwalior Unit), Distt.
Gwalior for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 468, 471 and 120-B of IPC.

entities.text:

Gwalior
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the case of the present applicant is identical and akin to that of co-accused Sahab Singh Kushwah and Mahendra Singh Rawat, who have been granted benefit of anticipatory bail by this Court vide order dated 04.02.2026 passed in M.Cr.C. No.5408 of 2026 and 10.03.2026 passed in M.Cr.C. No.11009 of 2026.
On the ground of parity, it is argued that the applicant is entitled to the same relief.

Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for bail; however, he fairly does not dispute the fact that the case of the present applicant stands on similar footing to that of co-accused Sahab Singh Kushwah and Mahendra Singh Rawat.
Heard counsel for parties and perused the case diary.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-GWL:10755 2 MCRC-13715-2026

The case of the applicant appears to be similar to that of co-accused Sahab Singh Kushwah and Mahendra Singh Rawat, who have been granted benefit of anticipatory bail by the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court.

In the absence of any distinguishing feature pointed out by the prosecution and in view of the principle of parity,
this Court sees no reason to take a different view from that taken in the case of the aforesaid co-accused persons.

sentences.text: Considering the facts and circumstances brought on record and to maintain parity, this Court is inclined to grant the benefit of anticipatory bail to the present applicant.
Thus, without commenting upon the merits of the case, this application is allowed.

It is hereby directed that in the event of arrest, the applicant shall be enlarged on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer for her appearance before it during the course of investigation or before the trial Court concerned during trial, as the case may be.

The applicant shall further abide by other conditions enumerated under Section 482 (2) of the B.N.S.S. and shall cooperate in the investigation, otherwise this bail order shall automatically stand cancelled.
Certified copy as per rules.

(RAJESH KUMAR GUPTA ) JUDGE (LJ*)
